1.1.1.1-n16-c1.reason: Burton's point that our sins bring calamities on us matches 'because of their transgression ... are afflicted'; he quotes the same verse for this idea in 1.2.1.1.

1.1.1.1-n9-c1.reason: Burton quotes it nearly word for word: 'Man in honour that understandeth not, is like unto beasts that perish.'
